purpose: Validate coordination reservations and compare-and-swap transitions without mutating repository state.
invariants: A transition is accepted only when expected HEAD equals current HEAD.
A new run ID must not already exist.
A new reservation must use conditional HEAD updates and its own branch.
Existing active third-party reservations and their files cannot be removed or weakened.
Different active runs cannot reserve the same file.
Auxiliary release scope must be a subset of the current run's reserved files.
scenarios: deduplicate current/subtask/active reservation aliases for the same run
accept a disjoint new reservation while preserving the existing owner
reject third-party release or file removal
allow release of own reservation only
